content.text: {"subject":"Math","mode":"concept","extracted_questions":[],"concept_explanation":"When you add 24 + 13, break it into tens and ones: 24 is 20 + 4, and 13 is 10 + 3. Add the tens together (20 + 10 = 30) and the ones together (4 + 3 = 7), then combine them: 30 + 7 = 37. You could also count on from 24: add 10 to get 34, then add 3 more to reach 37.","aditiApplicable":true,"aditiHook":"Think about money: if you have 24 rupees and someone gives you 13 more, how much do you have altogether?"}
